note: Hand-authored. The buff/debuff behaviour the web build adds or changes on top of the Java-baked tables (statuses, status-mechanics, debuff-producers). Every rule here follows the status's own description; where the description is silent the rule is a design decision and says so in its note.

roundPasses.note: When a status is counted down and does its per-round work, by the tickPhase statuses.json gives it: ACTIVE_OWNER_ROUND at the start of its owner's turn (before it acts), OWNER_TURN_END at the end of its owner's turn. ACTION_TRIGGER and CHARGE statuses are spent by actions, INSTANT ones never stay. Characteristic-owned instances (sourceSkill >= 1000) keep their own lifecycle.

sucLuc.note: Súc Lực: the next damaging skill hits with at least the stored Power (190). A skill that already has more Power keeps its own: a buff never lowers a hit.

electricPp.note: Điện áp: every skill used while it lasts costs 2 PP instead of 1.

followUpHit.note: Gia Tốc: each of the next two damaging skills hits a second time with the Power stored on the buff (60); the second hit carries no effect. One charge is spent per damaging skill.

selfHit.note: Quỷ Mị (8) and Hỗn Loạn (9) are spent by their owner's next action. The chance a damaging skill turns on its user comes from status-mechanics debuffActionSelfHitChance. Hỗn Loạn also replaces the chosen skill with a random usable one. A self-hit deals the skill's damage to its user and applies none of its effects.

turnSkip.name: Tê Liệt
turnSkip.note: Design decision (the description only says it lasts 2 turns): besides its −20% agility, each action has a 25% chance to be lost to the paralysis.

rainbowDebuffs.name: Hóa Đá
rainbowDebuffs.note: Mất hành động kế tiếp và giảm 30% sát thương nhận; hết khi hành động bị mất. Khác buff Thạch Hóa (0:13).

rainbowDebuffs.name: Giam Cầm
rainbowDebuffs.note: Không đổi pet, không dùng item; vẫn đánh được. Linh xảo −primary% (15) qua projectAgility.

rainbowDebuffs.name: Hủ Thực
rainbowDebuffs.note: Đầu mỗi lượt của chủ: mất 3%, rồi 6%, rồi 9% HP tối đa.

rainbowDebuffs.name: Xé Rách
rainbowDebuffs.note: Cuối mỗi vòng mất primary% (4) HP tối đa; đã chạy qua tickVqsv4BleedingRoundEnd.

rainbowDebuffs.name: Ngủ
rainbowDebuffs.note: Mất 1 hành động; nhận damage trực tiếp thì tỉnh ngay.

lietHoaUndescribed.note: Mê Muội (1:1): the description only names it, so it keeps the −20% agility (primary) the data already stores. Design decision, change here if a different effect is wanted.
